reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in their DM to confirm the note: Dock 14 is now their dock for Marrow Fieldworks pickups.

- **What I checked:** GBrain has no earlier dock information for Marrow Fieldworks, so there was nothing to update or reconcile. The search ran in keyword-only mode, so a differently worded note could have been missed.
- **What I didn't save:** I kept the note out of GBrain and out of memory. Everyone can read GBrain, and Hollis asked to keep this private. I said so in my reply and offered to record it wherever they'd like.
- **What I didn't do:** I didn't post it anywhere else or share it with anyone, since they said no action was needed.
